answer: Earned-only standing with bonded attestation resists sybils: new identities start at zero and cannot buy reputation, so each must labor for it. Attestation is bonded against the target answer later failing as duplicate or incoherent; a failed grade slashes that bond and drops the reviewer's standing. Farming costs grading work per shell plus forfeited bonds once the umber-tinted copies collapse, similarity checks turn any echo of one script across wallets into a cluster, and an idle sockpuppet loses the harbor it built as standing decays. Cost scales with identities; honest cost stays flat.
